source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.2.2 (PDF 191-192) with both examples and the corrected even-n rule.

blocks.text: Median central tendency ka woh paimana hai jo data ko tarteeb (order) mein rakhne ke baad beech wali qeemat batata hai. Agar qeematon ki tadaad odd (taaq: 1, 3, 5...) ho to median bilkul beech wali qeemat hai. Agar tadaad even (juft: 2, 4, 6...) ho to median do beech wali qeematon ki average hai. Biology mein population size, bimari ke aam hone (disease prevalence) ya jism ki naap jaisi cheezon mein, jahan data normal (ghanti numa) tarah phaila na ho, median mean se behtar markaz dikhata hai.
Median ka koi aik formula nahi, balke is ke nikalne ke qadam (steps) hain.

items: Qadam 1: data ko barhti (ascending) ya ghatti (descending) tarteeb mein rakhein.
Qadam 2: data mein qeematon ki kul tadaad (n) ginein.
Qadam 3: agar n odd ho to median ((n + 1)/2)ᵗʰ jagah wali qeemat hai.
Qadam 4: agar n even ho to median (n/2)ᵗʰ aur (n/2 + 1)ᵗʰ jagah wali do qeematon ki average hai.

blocks.text: Kitab ne qadam 4 mein doosri jagah ((n + 1)/2)ᵗʰ likhi hai. Even n ke liye yeh poora number nahi banti (n = 6 par 3.5). Sahih jaghein (n/2)ᵗʰ aur (n/2 + 1)ᵗʰ hain; n = 6 ke liye teesri aur chauthi qeemat, jaisa kitab ki apni misaal ((6 + 2)/2 = 4) mein hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
Misaal 1 (odd tadaad)
blocks.problem: Aik biologist ne baagh mein paanch paudon ki unchai (cm) naapi: 50cm, 65cm, 60cm, 75cm aur 80cm.
steps: Qadam 3: n = 5 odd hai, is liye median ((5 + 1)/2) = 3 jagah wali (teesri) qeemat hai.

blocks.title: Misaal 2 (even tadaad)
blocks.problem: Aik biologist ne chiriya ghar (zoo) ke chhe janwaron ka wazan (kg) naapa: 300kg, 400kg, 330kg, 315kg, 450kg aur 500kg.
steps: Qadam 3: n = 6 even hai, is liye median (6/2) = 3rd aur (6/2 + 1) = 4th qeematon ki average hai.

blocks.text: Kitab ne aakhri line 'Median = 330 + 400/2 = 365kg' bina brackets ke likhi hai. Sahih likhai (330 + 400)/2 = 365 kg hai; bina brackets ke 330 + 400/2 ka matlab 330 + 200 = 530 ban jata hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Kitab ne dono misalon ko 'Example 1' likha hai; yahan doosri ko Misaal 2 kaha gaya hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki do 'Example 1'

blocks.prompt: Chhe bachchon ki unchaiyan 110, 115, 118, 120, 122 aur 125 cm hain. Median kya hai?
blocks.explanation: n = 6 even hai, is liye median teesri aur chauthi qeemat ki average hai: (118 + 120)/2 = 119 cm.

items: Pehle data tarteeb mein rakhein; odd n: ((n + 1)/2)ᵗʰ qeemat; even n: (n/2)ᵗʰ aur (n/2 + 1)ᵗʰ ki average.
